resources.string: A video you send to CarPlay on the iPhone plays full screen on the tablet, as in a parked car. Plain web video (for example from Safari) plays; video protected with FairPlay, such as Apple TV+ or most paid streaming apps, does not. The video’s sound plays on the tablet, not on the PC. Applies at the next connection.
This video can\'t play on the tablet. Protected video, such as Apple TV+, needs a licensed receiver.
